<cfif x>
    <div>a</div>
<cfelse>
    <div>b</div>
</cfif>
<cfif onlyFirst>
    <p>first</p>
<cfelseif other>
    <cfset y = 2>
<cfelse>
    <cfset y = 3>
</cfif>
<cfif firstIsCfml>
    <cfset z = 1>
<cfelse>
    <p>html</p>
</cfif>
<cfif z>
    <cfset a = 1>
    <div>x</div>
</cfif>
<div>
    <cfif y>
        <b>y</b>
    </cfif>
</div>
<section>
    <cfif outer>
        <cfif inner>
            <span>deep</span>
        </cfif>
    </cfif>
</section>
<cfswitch expression="#x#">
    <cfcase value="1">
        <div>one</div>
    </cfcase>
    <cfdefaultcase>
        <cfset d = 1>
    </cfdefaultcase>
</cfswitch>
<cfoutput>
    Hello #name#,
    welcome back.
</cfoutput>
<cfloop array="#items#" item="item">
    #item.name#<br>
</cfloop>
<cfif commented>
    <!--- a note --->
    <li>listed</li>
</cfif>
<cfoutput>
    <!--- set first --->
    <cfset n = 1>
    <p>#n#</p>
</cfoutput>
<cfif x>
    <b>y</b>
</cfif>
<cfif x>yes</cfif>
<cfif withScript>
    <script>
    var result = someFunction(
        argumentNumberOne,
        argumentNumberTwo,
        argumentNumberThree,
        argumentNumberFourAndFive1234567,
    );
    </script>
</cfif>
<ul>
    <li>one</li>
</ul>
